concepts.title: 패치보드
concepts.name: Patchboard
concepts.description: 모듈을 장치처럼 구분하고 소켓과 케이블로 공유 호출을 드러내는 방향.

Exact identifiers: ApplyCoupon, IsValid, CalculateTotal, DiscountPercent, SetTotal, Read, Estimate. Show ApplyCoupon as selected entry; IsValid is validation, CalculateTotal is shared pricing, DiscountPercent is state, SetTotal writes state, Read presents totals, Estimate is a second consumer. Directed CALLS from ApplyCoupon to IsValid, CalculateTotal, SetTotal, Read; Estimate CALLS the SAME single CalculateTotal; CalculateTotal REFERENCES DiscountPercent. This is a static dependency map, NOT runtime sequence. Do not clone the shared CalculateTotal body. A chosen relationship has a readable "calls" or "references" label. Avoid decorative extra lines.
A compact readable explanation area with "Why this structure", Beginner / Expert choice, "Source-based explanation", exact phrase "Pricing is shared by ApplyCoupon and Estimate.", source label "CheckoutController.cs" and action "Open source". Display a small authentic snippet "pricing.CalculateTotal(cart.Subtotal)" and an unobtrusive "Meta analysis" action. Small functional preview of a cart can show "120 → 96" and a mug thumbnail if it fits; diagram remains the visual lead. Scope, zoom, search, selected/all links can be compact. Rounded cards in a standard SaaS dashboard are explicitly not the desired design; no KPI dashboard, giant hero slogan, arbitrary graphs, unreadable microtext or decorative sci-fi UI.

STYLE DIRECTION 01 — PRECISION PATCHBOARD. A sophisticated digital modular instrument for software architecture, tactile graphite aluminum with restrained cream silk-screen labels, coral actuator units, sage state cartridges and amber shared-logic bus. This must feel like a purpose-built code instrument rather than familiar web cards. FRONT-ON readable screen, not an actual physical synthesizer photograph. Main canvas a dark finely textured patchboard with bold differentiated component silhouettes: a tall selected ApplyCoupon controller plate with four labeled output sockets; a compact hexagonal IsValid gate; a wide central gold-edged CalculateTotal pricing cartridge with two input stems visibly meeting the same body; a slim horizontal DiscountPercent value capsule; SetTotal piston-shaped state writer; Read open frame; Estimate a secondary small controller. Carefully routed modest-width cables terminate at actual sockets, no tangles or gratuitous repeated dots. A single selected cable becomes brighter and labelled; shared pricing visually unmistakable. Very subtle 3px UI depth, crisp flat readable labels over it. Functional module details engraved on plates, measured space, warm gray inspector integrated as an instrument manual strip. Small hatching and precise fasteners only when they improve modular boundaries, not clutter. Strong industrial typographic identity and an amber accent navigation underline; include small zoom and pan tools. Result should be richer and unmistakably different from a generic node editor while practical for mouse/keyboard.

STYLE DIRECTION 03 — EXPLODED ASSEMBLY WORKSPACE. A precision 2.5D isometric exploded technical assembly WITHIN an ordinary desktop application. Pale blue-gray canvas, restrained pearl, periwinkle, mint, coral enamel parts, tiny contact shadows, sophisticated engineering product aesthetics. Modules are real distinguishable COMPONENT SHAPES with believable thin extruded depth: ApplyCoupon a central open controller chassis, IsValid small beveled gate, CalculateTotal a wide shared pricing processor with visible two separate upstream leads, DiscountPercent a sliding state cartridge, SetTotal a compact actuator, Read a display frame, Estimate another consumer part. Each module has a flat screen-aligned nameplate outside its isometric top, so absolutely no tilted illegible text. Open chassis exposes sockets and concise inner labels; parts spread apart enough to see connection surfaces. Raised components joined by fine orthogonal rails with directional arrows and type labels, no hovering magic or lights. Use a carefully bounded pale workbench with subtle coordinates, not an infinite VR world. Large central scene consumes 70% of screen; concise clean manual-style explanation drawer on right; compact real function nav across top and project dock down left. Selected part outlined in cobalt, unrelated parts remain visible with lower saturation. Visual richness comes from meaningful depth, cutaway edges, aligned assembly and material contrast, not pointless ornament. Strong visual scale contrast between controller and small state cartridge. Theme toggle clearly present. This is implementable with a 2D/2.5D desktop renderer, not a return to Unity/MR.

Source relationships drawn as beautifully controlled FLAT narrow ribbon bands across a horizontal workspace, each starts at a labelled module socket and ends at its actual target. Open folded module reveals a few readable labels, not decorative illegible code. Very shallow paper/sculpted depth, measured saturation, outstanding visual craft.
